messages:
jenny_support: FYI customer ACME sees dashboards go blank when they select Region=eu + Model=rl-llamafam + Version=v1.3. If they drop region or version the charts return. Ticket INC-3421. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/ACME/shot123 :eyes:

raj_backend: Can you paste the exact UI steps and the request id from the console? Also which timeframe?

jenny_support: Steps:
1) Console -> Analytics -> Model Usage
2) Filters: Region = eu, Model = rl-llamafam (from org alias), Version = v1.3, Last 24h
3) Apply -> charts empty
Request id: r-2026-03-16-ACME-555
Log snippet I grabbed from support logs: ```{"ts":"2026-03-16T14:21:02Z","req":"r-2026-03-16-ACME-555","query":{"region":"eu","model":"rl-llamafam","version":"v1.3"},"rows":0}```

maya_product: Quick q: did the model naming change recently? Is rl-llamafam an alias for rl-llama-family?

raj_backend: Yes, that alias was normalized in model-catalog last month -> canonical name `rl-llama-family`. My hunch: the UI multi-filter intersection code is using the raw selected keys (aliases) to intersect pre-aggregated buckets keyed by canonical model+version, so it ends up matching nothing when both model alias and region are present.

logan_sre: Can you repro with a direct DB query? If aggregator returns zero rows that's different from dashboard hiding rows.

jenny_support: Ran a quick adhoc in console db (read-only): ```SELECT count(*) FROM metrics WHERE region='eu' AND model='rl-llama-family' AND version='v1.3' AND time>now()-interval '24h'; -- returns 312``` So data exists under canonical name. But UI request used `model=rl-llamafam` and backend returned zero.

raj_backend: Confirmed. My local trace shows filter parsing path:
```js
// simplified
let filters = parseFilters(req.query) // returns {model: 'rl-llamafam', version: 'v1.3'}
let buckets = getPreaggBuckets(timeRange) // keyed by canonical names e.g. 'rl-llama-family@v1.3'
let intersect = intersectBuckets(buckets, filters) // uses raw filter keys => no match
```
We should normalize aliases during parseFilters.

maya_product: Workaround for support/customer: ask them to select model from the canonical list or remove region filter. Which is better?

raj_backend: Short term: ask them to pick the model from the dropdown (which shows canonical names) or remove region filter. I just pushed a quick patch to normalize model aliases before intersection — will run through CI and can hotfix to staging. ETA ~30m if pipeline is green. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploybot: deploy pipeline queued for patch/normalize-filtering. Job: deploy/patch-normalize-18765 -> staging -> canary -> prod if green.

logan_sre: Add a regression test for multi-select + aliasing so this doesn't slip back in.

raj_backend: Will add unit + e2e. Also creating a GH issue with repro and linking INC-3421.

jenny_support: Customer tried the dropdown workaround and reports charts back. They've accepted the workaround and would like ETA. I passed along the 30m-ish ETA.

maya_product: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1289 with repro steps and logs. I'll update INC-3421 and mark customer notified. :+1:

jenny_support: Thanks team. I'll keep the ticket open until prod fix is live and I'll confirm with ACME once canary completes.
